200.description:
Paginated park search around a point (latitude/longitude or a place name resolved through the site's autocomplete) with optional dates, guests, pets, site type (rv, tent, lodging), amenities, park features, minimum rating and RV constraints; sorted by distance or rating. Each result carries park_id, booking slug, coordinates, distance, availability for the requested dates, starting price, categories, features and rating. Filters other than dates/guests are soft on the site: non-matching parks are still returned with matches_filters false.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `parks` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `address` | string |  |

| `availability` | string | AVAILABLE or UNAVAILABLE for the requested dates and party as the site states it. |
| `available_campsite_categories` | string[] |  |
| `booking_url` | string |  |
| `city` | string |  |
| `distance_miles` | number | The site's distanceFromUser (miles from the search centre, rounded by the site). |
| `image_url` | string |  |
| `latitude` | number |  |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `matches_filters` | boolean |  |
| `name` | string | The site's displayName. |
| `organization_id` | number |  |
| `overall_rating` | number | Campspot rating out of 5 as the site states it (0 when ratings_count is 0). |
| `park_features` | string[] |  |
| `park_id` | number |  |
| `park_url` | string |  |
| `ratings_count` | number |  |
| `slug` | string | Booking slug (/book/{slug}); input to get_park. |
| `starting_price` | number | Lowest nightly price the site shows for the search, in the park's currency (see get_park currency_unit); null when the site shows none (typically unavailable parks). |

post.description:
Turn free text ('Austin', 'Yellowstone', a park name) into coordinates or a park_id before search_parks or get_park. search_parks also accepts the text directly through its `location` input.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

query.description: Place or park name fragment, as typed into the site's search box.

resolve_coordinates.description: When true, each place suggestion is resolved to latitude/longitude with one extra request per place (at most 10). Park suggestions always carry coordinates.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Destination and park suggestions for a typed place or park name, from Campspot's search-box autocomplete. Places carry a location_metadata_id (resolved to coordinates when resolve_coordinates is true); parks carry their park_id, marketplace slug and coordinates directly.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `suggestions` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `aggregator_slug` | string | Marketplace slug for parks (the /park/{aggregator_slug} path segment; not the booking slug, so use park_id with get_park); null for places. |
| `kind` | string | `place`: a geographic destination (city, region, national park); `park`: a bookable Campspot park. |
| `latitude` | number | Coordinates: always present for parks; for places only when resolve_coordinates was true. |
| `location_metadata_id` | string | Opaque place id (base64 Mapbox URN) for places; null for parks. |
| `longitude` | number |  |
| `name` | string | The site's fullLocationName. |
| `park_id` | number | Numeric park id for parks (input to get_park and get_park_availability); null for places. |
| `park_location` | string | City and region of the park as the site states it; null for places. |
| `park_url` | string | https://www.campspot.com/park/{aggregator_slug} for parks; null for places. |
